method: The full-resolution direct-Rumsey scan was opened in QGIS. Four engraved meridians and two engraved parallels were read from the sheet, followed across the mapped area, and measured independently at all eight crossings. A linen fold, heavy hydrography, roads, geological boundaries, hatching, text and the frame were excluded before corner checks were withheld.
qa_review: The top labels read 60d45mW, 60d40mW, 60d35mW and 60d30mW from west to east. The left labels read 46d45mN and 46d40mN from north to south. Full-resolution crops show the thin graticule continuing through the Whycocomagh River lettering, Barrens roads and brooks, geological colour, the prominent central fold and southern hatching without confusing those features for the retained rules.
